pipeline.index: VAST VSS (team-49), clips referenced by original_video
notes: Replay of recorded street cameras from the event archive (San Francisco, New York), not a live store feed.
Each 5 s piece is tracked separately, so a person seen in two pieces counts twice: numbers are person-sightings, not unique shoppers.
Age, gender, height and fit are not inferred, by design.
Labels are model output (W&B vision) and can be wrong; see the hand check.
Where the vision model returned only a colour, a generic noun (top / bottoms / item) was added; no garment type was invented.
Scene captions under the replay are the original Cosmos3-Reason descriptions stored in our VAST VSS index (gender words replaced with neutral ones).
